$comment: The merge gate for main. pnpm invariants checks this file against .github/workflows/ci.yml; tools/check-ruleset-drift.mjs checks it against the live ruleset and prints the body that applies it. Change the ruleset only from this file.

nonGatingJobs.verify (windows-latest, node 24): Bootstrap phase: runs on every PR and on main, but a Windows-only failure must not hold up merges until the first release; gate it again afterwards.
